summary: Feed s073_single to APM is degraded due to 7.7% duplicate packets (178/2308) exceeding 5% threshold. All other visibility checks (one-way, drops, overload, truncation, tunnels, VLAN, encryption, oversize) are healthy.

findings.root_cause: Packet broker is forwarding the same packets twice, typically from aggregating multiple SPAN/TAP sources that see the same flow without deduplication enabled.
findings.impact_on_tool: APM will waste cycles processing duplicates, inflating transaction counts and skewing latency/retransmission metrics and potentially masking real performance issues.

recommended_fix.why: Enable packet-broker deduplication to drop identical packets seen within a short window before delivery to the 10G APM port, bringing duplicate rate below 5% without losing unique traffic.
